name: Should I hire a professional or fix bathroom drywall myself?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a professional or fix bathroom drywall myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a homeowner can patch a minor nail hole or shallow surface ding, water leaks, large cutouts, and shower surrounds should be handled by a professional. Poorly sealed joints or standard materials installed near plumbing fixtures allow humidity to seep behind walls, which encourages concealed rot and mold. Professional remodeling contractors ensure the correct board type is installed, structural backing is solid, and moisture barriers remain continuous.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY repairs are fine for tiny holes, but water damage, ceiling patches, and areas around plumbing require professional work to prevent hidden mold and structural issues.
